The '''Cal-Seti system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Torranix sector/Legends|Torranix sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cal-Seti/Legends|Cal-Seti]].
